pattern_language.nodes: variable -> optional {type: exact CCO/BFO class label, attributes: exact-match attribute filters}
pattern_language.edges: [source_var, predicate_id, target_var]; all must be present in the filtered graph; node variables bind injectively

reference_conditions.label: Specification conformance of a measured quality
reference_conditions.description: Where a specification prescribes a quality borne by an artifact and a measurement of that quality exists, the measured value must lie within the specification's prescribed bounds.

value_fact_steps.effect: bring the artifact's quality back within the prescribed bounds or segregate it

reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: Every measurement of the prescribed quality lies within the specification bounds, or the artifact is segregated by a rework act.

objective.label: maintain artifact conformity to specification
objective.description: Manufactured artifacts conform to the qualities their specifications prescribe.
objective.rationale: A measured value outside the prescribed bounds is a direct non-conformity of the artifact to its specification.

reference_conditions.label: Drift response in a measurement sequence
reference_conditions.description: Where three successive measuring acts on lots from the same manufacturing act produce monotonically increasing values of the same measurand, an act of artifact modification on the producing machine must follow the third measuring act.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: An act of artifact modification on the producing machine follows the last measuring act of the drifting sequence.

objective.label: maintain artifact conformity to specification
objective.description: Manufactured artifacts conform to the qualities their specifications prescribe.
objective.rationale: An unanswered monotone drift foreseeably carries the produced quality out of conformity.

reference_conditions.label: Corrective action on a nonconformance report
reference_conditions.description: Where a nonconformance report is about a lot, a corrective-action act taking that report as input must exist.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: A corrective-action act has the nonconformance report as input.

objective.label: satisfy institutional and regulatory obligations
objective.description: Obligations attached to roles, quality systems and regulations are discharged.
objective.rationale: Quality-system obligations require every nonconformance report to be closed by a corrective action.

reference_conditions.label: Nonconforming product control in directives
reference_conditions.description: Where a nonconformance report and a directive are both about the same lot and the directive is the output of a decision act, that decision act must have the report as input.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: The decision act that produced the directive has the nonconformance report as input.

objective.label: satisfy institutional and regulatory obligations
objective.description: Obligations attached to roles, quality systems and regulations are discharged.
objective.rationale: Disposition of nonconforming product must be decided with the nonconformance record before it.

reference_conditions.label: Hazard control before operational use
reference_conditions.description: Where a safety-relevant disposition is borne by a lot that participates in an operational-use process, a hazard-control act on the lot must precede that use.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: A hazard-control act on the lot precedes its operational use.

objective.label: prevent foreseeable harm to persons
objective.description: Processes that affect persons do not carry uncontrolled safety-relevant dispositions.
objective.rationale: A safety-relevant disposition in service without prior control is a foreseeable path to harm.

reference_conditions.label: Completeness of conformance communication
reference_conditions.description: Where a communication delivers a conformance-asserting certificate about a lot to a recipient and a nonconformance report about the same lot exists, a communication delivering that report to the same recipient must exist.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: The recipient of the certificate has also received the nonconformance report.

objective.label: preserve informed agency of affected persons
objective.description: Parties with an interest in a process receive the information needed to act on it.
objective.rationale: A recipient who holds only the conformance assertion cannot exercise informed judgment about the lot.

reference_conditions.label: Role obligation to report upward
reference_conditions.description: Where a person in a role performs a nonconformance-reporting act and their role is subordinate to another role, they must communicate to the bearer of the superior role.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: The reporting person has communicated to each bearer of a superior role.

objective.label: satisfy institutional and regulatory obligations
objective.description: Obligations attached to roles, quality systems and regulations are discharged.
objective.rationale: Upward reporting is an obligation attached to a subordinate role.

reference_conditions.label: Supervisory response to an escalation
reference_conditions.description: Where an escalation communication from a subordinate is received by the bearer of a superior role, the superior must perform an act with the subordinate as recipient.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: Each superior who received the escalation has performed an act with the escalating person as recipient.

objective.label: maintain reliable organizational decision information
objective.description: Organizational decisions take the relevant records as input and close escalation loops.
objective.rationale: An escalation with no response leaves the organization's information loop open.

reference_conditions.label: Information to interested parties about a hazardous lot in use
reference_conditions.description: Where a party has an interest in an operational-use process in which a lot bearing a safety-relevant disposition participates, a communication with that party as recipient must exist.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: Every interested party has been the recipient of a communication.

objective.label: preserve informed agency of affected persons
objective.description: Parties with an interest in a process receive the information needed to act on it.
objective.rationale: Persons with an interest in a process cannot participate in decisions about it unless addressed.

reference_conditions.label: Regulatory notification of a safety-relevant nonconformance
reference_conditions.description: Where a regulation prescribes a quality-management process and a safety-relevant nonconformance report exists, a communication delivering that report to a government organization must exist.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: A government organization has received a communication carrying the nonconformance report.

objective.label: satisfy institutional and regulatory obligations
objective.description: Obligations attached to roles, quality systems and regulations are discharged.
objective.rationale: The regulation makes notification of safety-relevant nonconformance an institutional obligation.

reference_conditions.label: Decision informed by a preceding report communication
reference_conditions.description: Where a communication carrying a nonconformance report precedes a decision act, the decision act must have that report as input.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: The decision act has the communicated report as input.

objective.label: maintain reliable organizational decision information
objective.description: Organizational decisions take the relevant records as input and close escalation loops.
objective.rationale: A decision that follows a report but does not take it as input is made on unreliable information.

reference_conditions.label: Hold by the agent whose decision causes shipment after escalation
reference_conditions.description: Where a decision act by a person follows a communication carrying a nonconformance report and causes a shipment, a hold act by that person must precede the shipment.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: A hold act by the deciding person precedes the shipment.

objective.label: prevent foreseeable harm to persons
objective.description: Processes that affect persons do not carry uncontrolled safety-relevant dispositions.
objective.rationale: The agent whose decision propagates a reported nonconformance is positioned to interrupt it.

reference_conditions.label: Interruption of a chain of effect reaching affected persons
reference_conditions.description: Where an act produced a nonconformance report, a communication carried it, a decision followed and caused a shipment whose lot participates in a use that affects a party, a hazard-control act on the lot must precede that use.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: A hazard-control act on the lot precedes the use that affects the party.

objective.label: prevent foreseeable harm to persons
objective.description: Processes that affect persons do not carry uncontrolled safety-relevant dispositions.
objective.rationale: The chain from reported nonconformance to affected persons is uninterrupted.

reference_conditions.label: Containment of material bearing a safety-relevant disposition
reference_conditions.description: Where a lot bears a safety-relevant disposition and is a continuant part of an assembly, that assembly must not participate in an operational-use process.
reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: No operational-use process has the containing assembly as participant.

objective.label: prevent foreseeable harm to persons
objective.description: Processes that affect persons do not carry uncontrolled safety-relevant dispositions.
objective.rationale: Material with an uncontrolled safety-relevant disposition must be contained, not placed in service.
